Nora (CS): Heads-up 4 Starlake dedicated bring-up approved for 8 GPUs. Customer target: 95th < 140ms for chat. Need a short, executable plan: priming, autoscale values, chaos rehearsal, and acceptance checklist. Who owns what?
Ben (Infra): I can own provisioning + priming. Plan: 8 GPU reserved pool, run prefix warmer + KV seed for 6h pre-test. Priming command: `./ops/prime_pool --env=prod --pool=starlake --hours=6`.
Jia (SRE): II'll own monitoring, alerts, and rollback playbook. Quick SLOs: p95 < 140ms, p99 < 300ms, error_rate < 0.5%. Alerts: p95>160ms 5m -> paged; p99>320ms 3m -> pager.
Marco (PE): II'll coordinate customer validation and prompt pack. Need to run 1k mixed prompts during soak and capture embeddings for drift check. Will ask customer for final acceptance window.
Nora (CS): Two constraints: 1) customer renewal in 22 days; 2) they want automatic fallback within 120s if tail latency spikes. Please make fallback deterministic.
Ben (Infra): Autoscale proposal: min=3, start=5, max=12, step=1, scale_up_trigger=65% util for 90s, scale_down=25% for 180s. For ramp window we'll shorten cooldowns to 45s.
Jia (SRE): Rollback/fallback snippet we'll use: `POST /v1/routing/switch {from: "starlake-pool", to: "hosted-fallback", timeout_s:120}`. Also attach a token-throttle bucket during failover.
infra-bot: Canary job queued: `canary/starlake/soak-1` scheduled at 2026-06-09T15:00:00Z (job id 9921).
Marco (PE): Acceptance checklist: auth + KMS verify, latency & errors within thresholds, prompt-quality sample (500 prompts) with embedding cosine >= baseline -0.02, and signed customer acceptance.
Nora (CS): Action items:
- Ben: provision pool + run priming (owner)
- Jia: add alerts + attach runbook + create fallback playbook (owner)
- Marco: deliver prompt pack + collect sign-off (owner)
- Nora: draft renewal status update for AMs (owner)
Please confirm by EOD and paste links to runbooks/tooling here. :thumbsup:
